context_requirements: Basal or induced ICAM1 expression in the assayed cell line
An inflammatory or adhesion stimulus that drives ICAM1 transcription
Expression of the ICAM1 transcriptional activator program (e.g., NF-kB, STAT1, IRF1)
falsifiers: A reproducible decrease in ICAM1 mRNA at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Coordinate suppression of an ICAM1-dependent inflammatory or adhesion gene program
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes consistent with ICAM1 pathway inhibition
